name: Diesel-driven emergency generator with UPS/battery banks
description: Emergency/essential diesel generator packages supply emergency, essential and main loads on ISO/IEC offshore units; JIP33 S-714-1J sets starting, battery, cooling, excitation and testing requirements. UPS/battery banks bridge the gap to generator pickup and support black start; the Equinor patent and Shell Timi design give battery/UPS architecture and energy levels. USCG/IEEE practice defines essential-generation loads including HVAC, potable water, instrument air and crane auxiliaries.
aliases: Diesel-driven emergency generator with UPS/battery banks

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Independent starting systems for emergency service
specifications.basis: Diesel engines in emergency generator service shall have two independent starting systems

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Cranking cycles without recharge
specifications.unit: cycles of 15 s cranking + 15 s rest
specifications.basis: Starting systems shall be rated for handling three consecutive cranking cycles, each of 15 s of cranking and 15 s of rest, without recharging the battery or pressurizing the air vessel or hydraulic oil accumulator

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Radiator / air cooler design margin
specifications.unit: % of heat load at maximum engine power
specifications.basis: Radiators or external air coolers shall be designed for 110 % of the heat load at the maximum engine power, at the maximum ambient design temperature

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Water-cooled heat exchanger design margin
specifications.basis: Water-cooled heat exchangers shall be designed for 110 % of the maximum heat load at the maximum cooling medium inlet temperature

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Insulated bearing threshold
specifications.basis: Bearing insulation shall be provided for generators with shaft voltage greater than 350 mV RMS value

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Personnel hot-surface protection threshold
specifications.basis: In areas that are accessible during operation and inspection, protection against potential injury from surfaces exceeding 60 °C (140 °F) shall be provided

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Baseplate mounting pad flatness
specifications.basis: Baseplate mounting pads shall be flat and parallel with each other to within 0,15 mm/m (0,002 in/ft)

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Baseplate surface finish
specifications.basis: The surface finish of baseplate mounting areas shall not exceed Ra 3,2 µm (125 µin)

specifications.metric: Diesel generator package (emergency/esse — Lifting provision threshold
specifications.basis: Components over 25 kg (55 lb) requiring removal for maintenance shall have lifting lugs or provisions for lifting eyebolts
